answer: The system prices honesty with an insurance stake: every identity locks 200 units, forfeited on a failed audit. Audits work by mirror: a peer re-performs the agent's last task and the outputs must match, so ten clones must pass ten separate mirrors. Each epoch a gale of 40 unannounced audits hits random identities, each carried out by a raven drawn only after the work is submitted, so clones cannot pre-arrange a verdict. A Sybil operator pays 200 units per fake plus the full cost of real work for each.
